query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**As of July 2026, the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice lists 23 full signatories** (last official update: 23 April 2026), plus **xAI** as a partial signatory (Safety & Security Chapter only).

**The 23 full signatories:** Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, Google, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, and WRITER.

**Notable non-signatories:** Meta, plus major Chinese providers (Alibaba, Baidu, DeepSeek).

The count of 23 was confirmed stable from the April 2026 update through early July 2026. The one caveat is that the Commission updates the page on a rolling basis, so the exact live figure could differ slightly if any provider signed between late April and mid-July 2026 — though I found no evidence of additions beyond the 23.

key_facts: The EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory list contained 23 full signatories as of the 23 April 2026 official update, unchanged through early July 2026.
xAI is a partial signatory, having signed only the Safety and Security Chapter, and must show transparency/copyright compliance by alternative means.

The 23 full signatories are: Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, Google, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, WRITER.
Meta is the most prominent AI provider to decline signing the Code (as of January 2026).
Major Chinese AI providers (Alibaba, Baidu, DeepSeek) have not signed.
The European Commission updates the signatory list on a rolling basis and notes some signatories may not appear immediately.
Major AI labs Amazon, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Mistral AI have all signed the full Code.
